summary: Prepared GAIA is the most professionally organized variant, featuring separate agent modules and robust file-based logging. However, it shares the logical gaps of the original GAIA implementation, relying on random truck selection and completely omitting the truck prioritization requirement (R6).

findings.evidence: The CollectorAgent tracks its load, but the CommunicatorAgent never considers this load level when selecting a truck.
FindBestGarbageTruckBehaviour uses random.choice(available_collectors) instead of calculating proximity.
Each agent (Collector, Communicator, Container) maintains its own .log file with structured timestamps.

implementation_risks: Random truck selection will lead to significantly higher operational costs and 'unnecessary operations' mentioned in the project description.
